subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's opt-in agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs knob and per-run fence semantics as the core fix for wedged deferred turn maintenance, or should the fix reuse an existing compaction safety-timeout policy instead?
rationale: The code path is sound and well proven, but the permanent timeout budget source and new config surface are product/API decisions under the repository's high config-surface bar.

options.title: Accept opt-in timeout knob
options.body: Land this PR after maintainer review if the separate disabled-by-default operator knob is the desired policy for background maintenance wedges.

options.title: Reuse existing safety timeout
options.body: Ask the author or a replacement PR to consolidate on the existing compaction safety-timeout budget so OpenClaw avoids another config key.

options.title: Pause until one canonical PR wins
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until maintainers choose between this branch and the newer alternative timeout PR.

recommendation.title: Accept opt-in timeout knob
recommendation.body: Land this PR after maintainer review if the separate disabled-by-default operator knob is the desired policy for background maintenance wedges.

likelyOwner.reason: They contributed the final background turn-maintenance routing commits in the feature-origin PR and are a strong decision owner for this scheduler/config boundary.
